title: StakeoutAnalysisDraftSchema
description: Analysis response contract for crypto scam oracle graph intelligence (Deliverable for Person 2: Backend)

clusterId.description: bytes32 cluster identifier formatted as 0x + 64 hex characters

behaviorScore.description: Scam behavior score normalized between 0.0 and 1.0

signals.description: List of risk signals or signal metrics (e.g. fanIn, fanOut, passThroughRatio, totalIn, totalOut)

members.description: Addresses identified as belonging to the same behavioral cluster

exitPoints.description: Identified exit point addresses (e.g. mixers, bridge deposits, off-ramps)

linked.description: True if the target wallet is linked to a known or suspicious cluster

reason.description: Human and oracle readable explanation of the risk assessment

dataSource.description: Origin of the underlying graph data

createdAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the analysis execution
